description: Espressif ESP32-S3 dual-core Xtensa LX7 microcontroller @ 240MHz

usb.note: ESP32-S3 has native USB-OTG (plus the fixed Serial/JTAG controller). Unlike ESP32-C3 it can expose CDC and HID keyboards over USB; HID primitives (%hid-*) are hardware-supported but not yet compiled into the firmware.
